Modifier

Scope

Colour overlay

Fills the target's visible pixels with this colour. Transparency is kept.

Transform

Drag the box to move, a corner to scale, an edge to stretch and the knob to rotate (Shift: 15° steps). Like the transform tool, the result is clipped to the canvas.

Adjustment

Adjustments change colour and tone per pixel. They follow the same Scope rules as other modifiers.

Stroke

Offset moves the stroke away from the source (positive leaves a gap) or into it (negative).

Outlines the visible shape of the layers in its Scope. Outside grows the shape, inside cuts into it, centre straddles the edge. Width variation swells and thins the outline smoothly across the canvas. Source smoothing removes stair-stepping from the shape before the outline is measured.

Align & distribute

Drag inside the bounds to move. Drag corner handles inward or outward to scale about the opposite corner. Shift preserves aspect ratio. Alt-drag a node to swivel the image in 3D; Shift constrains the tilt axis. Perspective: move the four corners. Warp: move grid points. Liquify: drag to push pixels with a soft brush. Deforming linked or text layers rasterises them on Apply; Undo restores the link. Snap layout aligns object edges or centre with canvas edges and centre lines. The round handle rotates. Crop: drag a rectangle, then adjust its corners. Shift snaps rotation to 15°. Apply to commit; switching tools also applies.

Click the canvas to place the horizon · drag its centre to move it and the end handles to rotate it (Shift snaps to 15°) · double-click the centre to level it. Vanishing points near the line snap onto it and then slide along it; dragging the horizon snaps it through free vanishing points.

Vanishing points

Click the canvas to place a point, drag its coloured handle to move it, double-click to remove it. H locks a point to the horizon.

Find horizon

Drag two lines along edges that recede to the same point, for example the two sides of a road. The horizon is placed where they cross; drag the end handles to refine. With two lines present, dragging on empty canvas replaces the older one.

Marching ants mark 50% coverage. Hold Shift to add, Alt to subtract, Shift+Alt to intersect when starting a selection. Ctrl locks proportions. Selections apply across layers.

Guides, margins & bleed

Individual guides

Margins appear inside the canvas; bleed appears outside. Guides follow the canvas when artwork is rescaled, and can be used by Transform’s guide snapping.

Autosave backups

.bung keeps editable layers, groups and selection. PNG export is a flattened image. Undo history stays in this session.

Bungalow documents

Photoshop documents

OpenRaster documents

Krita documents

Opens as a document at its original size. Preserves supported paint layers and groups. Transparency masks and supported group effects are baked only where needed; other unsupported features offer a whole-image fallback. Save the result as a Bungalow project.

Place into document

Files are centred on new layers. Documents are placed as a composited image; open or import them to keep editable layers. Original-size images extending past the canvas are cropped. You can also paste an image with Ctrl+V (⌘V on Mac).

Palettes

Select and export saved palettes from the Palette panel menu.

Export

PNG options

Lossless PNG · includes layer opacity and effects. PNG options also apply to selected-node exports.

Each selected layer or composited group becomes its own PNG, all in one ZIP, using the DPI and transparency settings above.

Keeps layers, groups, opacity and blend modes editable. Value masks become transparency masks on the layers they affect.

Layered 8-bit RGB at the document size and DPI. Modifiers are baked into the layers they affect.

Layered OpenRaster. Unsupported effects are baked.
